title: Raj Sisodia: Incorruptible 'belongs on the bookshelf of every leader in the world'
summary: Sisodia co-founded the Conscious Capitalism movement and holds the FEMSA chair in Conscious Enterprise at Tecnológico de Monterrey. He went on The Eric Ries Show as a guest, and posted afterwards about the conversation — what it takes to sustain a purpose-driven enterprise that operates for the benefit of all of humanity. His verdict is in two parts: a judgement about Eric's standing in the field, and a one-line instruction about the book. This is his second endorsement; the first, in October, recommended it to Conscious Capitalists specifically. This one widens it to every leader there is.
blockquote: Eric is one of the most important thinkers, writers, advisors, and influencers active in the world of business and leadership today, and it was a pleasure to exchange ideas with him. His new book “Incorruptible” belongs on the bookshelf of every leader in the world.
